notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale: the seller personally solicits (including at the buyer's invitation), price $25 or more, agreement made away from the seller's place of business; only a visit to repair or maintain the buyer's personal property is excepted, and anything extra sold on that visit is covered
notices.format: Statement near the signature in 10 point bold; oral notice also required
notices.support: Remodeling, flooring, pools and hardscape sold at the home are door to door sales.
notices.summary_row: Statement beside the buyer's signature (10 point bold); oral notice
notices.block: 1. SDCL 37-24-5.3 (statement in the contract; oral notice)
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole statute section, which also contains the rules about oral notice and misrepresenting the right to cancel, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; the notice sentence needs to be cut out by hand.

notices.title: NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, in duplicate
notices.trigger: Door-to-door sale: the seller personally solicits (including at the buyer's invitation), price $25 or more, agreement made away from the seller's place of business
notices.format: Completed form in duplicate, attached to the contract and easily detachable, ten point bold, all capitals
notices.support: The form is all capitals in the statute and allows "AN ELECTRONIC NOTICE" of cancellation.
notices.summary_row: NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, in duplicate, 10 point bold, all capitals
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole statute section, with the seller's duty wording before the form and the instruction to complete both copies after it, so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract; the form itself needs to be cut out by hand.

changes.new: Three business days; only a visit to repair or maintain the buyer's personal property is excepted
changes.support: The repair exception is for the buyer's "personal property" only

unsure: SD-cancel and SD-cancel-form: the statute blocks are whole sections with seller-duty wording around the notice, so I held them rather than guess how much of that belongs in the contract.
